trial_court: Family Court - Cum - Additional District Judge, Nizamabad (O.P.No.158 of 2013)
case_name: Jadhav Raja Rajeshwari vs G Praveen Kumar
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed petition under Section 13 (1) (i) (a) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking dissolution of marriage with respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 has no application to the case on hand.
legal_principles.held: It was contended that the petitioner admittedly belongs to Scheduled Tribe (ST), whereas the respondent belongs to Scheduled Caste (SC) Mala. It was further contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that Sub - Section (2) of Section 2 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 expressly excludes the members of the Scheduled Tribes from application of the said Act.
cited_cases: Gullipilli Sowria Raj v. Bandaru Pavani @ Gullipilli Pavani
Kadavath Srikanth v. Kadavath Ashwitha @ Jadav Preethilekha

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to establish a voluntary love relationship.
legal_principles.held: It was submitted that in view of physical distance between them and the fact that they belong to different castes, the alleged marriage between the parties was neither practical, nor probable, more particularly in the light of these circumstances.
use_in: cases involving long-distance relationships or inter-caste marriages

use_for_drafting: providing legal advice on Hindu Marriage Act
